subject: No Vibes Allowed: Shipping in the Opus 5.5 Era
body:
Hello First Name,

This weeks 🦄 ai that works session was on "No Vibes Allowed: Shipping in the Opus 5.5 Era"!

The full recording, code, and diagrams from the session are now available on GitHub:
https://github.com/hellovai/ai-that-works

We covered a lot on how to ship software effectively in the Opus 5.5 era with smarter models and new workflows. Let's quickly go over the highlights:

We kicked things off by discussing **Orchestrator-Driven Workflows with Interactive Subagents**. The idea here is to move past simple main-chat-to-subagent models. Instead, you use an orchestrator to manage several *interactive* subagents. This is super useful for complex tasks like research, planning, and implementation flows, letting you work in parallel and do focused deep dives.

Next, we dove into **Decision-First Planning (L-Plan)**. This approach really streamlines how humans and AI work together. The model generates a full plan with default decisions and collapsed alternatives, which means you, the human, can efficiently review and jump in only when needed, instead of getting bogged down in a Q&A session.

We also really emphasized **Ambitious Engineering & Active Human Oversight**. This means being bold with AI-driven experiments (like compiler rewrites or test dependency tracing!) but always keeping a healthy dose of skepticism. Make sure to actively review code and design decisions (that 'Show Me' skill is key!), and always stay in context to guide your agent effectively and prevent messy output.

So, what's the big takeaway? Be ambitious with your AI agents, but keep that skepticism and stay actively engaged. Use orchestrators and decision-first planning to get the most out of them, and always review their output to maintain quality and avoid low-quality results.

What's coming up next? Dex mentioned a deep dive on Vaibhav's performance optimization work for next week's episode. We might also do another live stream on building the voice agent. Plus, Vaibhav suggested an episode on the system design and benefits of cloud agents.

If you have any questions, reply to this email or ask on Discord: https://www.boundaryml.com/discord. We read every message! Happy coding 🧑‍💻

Vaibhav & Dex
